title: Kissed Canadian Tofu Stew
description: A garlicky, tender stew that blends Canadian maple sweetness with fennel seed warmth, featuring double-fried tofu and simmered in a claypot for a romantic, jain-friendly meal.
instructions: Press tofu to remove excess moisture and cut into 1-inch cubes.
Heat 1 tablespoon olive oil in a skillet and double-fry tofu cubes until golden, then set aside on paper towels.
In the same skillet, add remaining oil and sauté minced garlic until fragrant.
Add fennel seeds, smoked paprika, thyme, salt, and pepper, cooking for 30 seconds.
Pour in vegetable broth and soy sauce, bring to a boil.
Stir in maple syrup, coconut milk, and the double-fried tofu, reduce heat and simmer for 15 minutes.
Taste and adjust seasoning if necessary.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley, directly from the claypot.
